title: Project
description: Workspace configuration (production/project.yaml): comic format, page geometry, color mode, lettering mode, style anchors, default provider, and repair policy. Every command reads its defaults from here.

comic_format.description: Selects the format rule layer: rules/paged/ or rules/webtoon/. In webtoon format a page is one scroll segment.

publication.description: Publication shape; drives issue planning and page budgets.

language.description: Language of the lettering (e.g. en, es).

reading_direction.description: Reading direction of panels and balloons.

page.description: Page geometry shared by every page of the project.

aspect_ratio.description: Page aspect ratio as width:height (e.g. "2:3"). Quote it in YAML.

trim_mm.description: Trim size of the printed page.

bleed_mm.description: Bleed beyond the trim, in millimetres.

safe_margin_mm.description: Margin inside the trim that lettering stays within, in millimetres.

color_mode.description: Color strategy for the whole comic.

spot_colors.description: Spot colors allowed on top of the color mode.

hex.description: Hex value, e.g. "#C0392B". Quote it in YAML.

use.description: The one thing this color is used for.

mode.description: in_image: the generator draws the text. overlay: letter-pages.js sets the text from lettering.yaml.

font_family.description: Font family used for overlay lettering and stated in prompts.

case.description: Letter case of balloons and captions.

max_words_per_balloon.description: Word budget per balloon or caption.

look_refs.description: Approved LOOK_* masters attached to every request as the style reference.

style_block.description: Path of the frozen style prompt block, relative to the workspace root.

influences.description: Artists, movements, or works that anchor the look.

notes.description: Short style reminders; the detail lives in style/style-bible.md.

image.description: Default image provider; one of the provider roster.

violence_treatment.description: How violence is shown on the page.

max_cycles.description: Maximum automatic repair cycles per page (repairs an agent or the studio starts after a blocking review) before the plan or the references are fixed instead. Default 2.

touch_up_warning.description: Edits of one image after which a touch-up the person asks for comes with a warning that more edits may degrade it, and the choice of a redraw from the plan. The person decides; the touch-up may go past max_cycles. Default 2.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
